# Sonaloop

> Sonaloop is an MCP server for customer-persona simulation, councils, and design-research
> synthesis. The host agent authors all text; Sonaloop gathers context, validates and
> persists — no server-side text-LLM calls. This file indexes the canonical documentation
> in agent-friendly raw markdown.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/getting-started.md): install one-liner, MCP registration, first project
- [Job → Framework → Format taxonomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/job-framework-format.md): the three-layer source-of-truth taxonomy
- [Frameworks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/frameworks.md): methodology frameworks a run can follow
- [Grounding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/grounding.md): evidence grounding and provenance
- [Calibration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/calibration.md): prediction calibration and Brier scoring
- [Opt-in aggregation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/opt-in-aggregation-design.md): sentiment/coverage aggregation model
- [Embeddings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/embeddings.md): semantic memory recall setup
- [Lifecycle hooks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/lifecycle-hooks.md): events and subscriptions
- [Substrate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/substrate.md): queryable backend substrate for extensions
- [Project assets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/project-assets.md): attaching asset evidence
- [Flow walkthrough](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/flow-walkthrough.md): live walkthrough mechanics
- [Live walkthrough safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/live-walkthrough-safety.md): safety constraints for live actuation
- [Selective live actuation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-docs/main/docs/selective-live-actuation.md): live prototype testing

## Optional

- [Core repository](https://github.com/jhoetter/sonaloop): source code, CLI, web inspector
- [Persona database](https://github.com/jhoetter/sonaloop-data): CRON-refreshed persona catalog
